feeds.title: melonDS
feeds.description: melonDS aims to provide fast and accurate Nintendo DS emulation. While it is still a work in progress, it has a pretty solid set of features. Their blog updates about the activity if the site, latest updates and much more intriguing stuff.

feeds.title: NoxPlayer Blog
feeds.description: NoxPlayer aims to provide the best experience for users to play android games and apps on a PC. Follow the NoxPlayer Blog to get information on the latest news, gaming updates, features, new games, guides for gamers, and more.

feeds.title: AEP Emulation Page - Emulation News
feeds.description: AEP Emulation Page is your one-stop solution for all your asks regarding the emulator world. The blog consists of Emulator News, Remakes, Virtual Machines, Gaming, Retro and Vintage, Highscore Competitions, Community, reviews and more.

feeds.title: dolphin-emu.org - Latest entries
feeds.description: Over the past four years, the Community Dolphin Discord Server, which was unaffiliated with the project itself, has become a fantastic community that has been providing support and a hub for Dolphin users. While it started out small, the server now boasts over 10,000 users and several of Dolphin's developers interact and help users directly on the server.

feeds.title: mGBA
feeds.description: mGBA is an open-source Game Boy Advance emulator, copyright Vicki Pfau. This project is not affiliated in any way with Nintendo. Game Boy Advance is a registered trademark of Nintendo Co., Ltd. Blog publishes articles on the latest, news, announcements, development, game tricks, and more.

feeds.title: Libretro Blog
feeds.description: Libretro Blog shares all the important information about the site, the latest updates, games, software, and emulators. Libretro is a simple but powerful development interface that allows for the easy creation of emulators, games, and multimedia applications that can plug straight into any libretto-compatible frontend. This development interface is open to others so that they can run these pluggable emulators and game cores also in their own programs or devices.
